translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: ID POKITA
book.title: DOS ID POKITA ni Disas Krays ki Juan

content: Dos Pittun Yohung no Noponnut Langot to Monama
Nopongnga idda, norinog ku no duwon monokkaan bawos pomon diyot templo no mid ungketen to, “Busbus dowd diyon to ampow't ingod iddos pittun yohung no noponnut langot to Monama.”

De-en id ipanow iddos unnon ponolihan, woy id busbus din iddos ta-aw taddot kandin no yohung diyon to livuta. Na idda ron en, id inguma iddos moka-arat-arat woy mosakit no pidsa riyot mgo minuvu no id pota-aw to patow taddot monnanap woy dos id ponsimba taddot ribultu rin.

Na, id busbus taddot iko-oruwon ponolihan iddos ta-aw taddot kandin no yohung diyon to dahat. Idda ron en, novauy idda no longossa iling to longossa to minatoy, woy dos langun no ngaap diyot dahat, id poomatoy.
Nopongnga idda, id busbus taddot iko-otollun ponolihan iddos ta-aw taddot kandin no yohung diyon to mgo oweg woy riyot mgo sobsob, woy idda ron en, novauy idda no longossa.
Na, norinog ku iddos ponolihan no id tamong to oweg no mid ikahi to,

content.text: “Uhis no Monama, duwon kad to waa pa iddos tigkonayan to ingod, ahad taman ko-ungkay,
Su id potihis dan kos longossa ukit to kod-imatoy taddot mgo minuvu ru woy taddot mgo propeta.
De-en ko-ungkay, longossa rad mandad kos id po-inom du oyyos idda en kos ollog kandan!”

content: Norinog ku no duwon bawos pomon diyot buwisanan no mid ungketen to,

content.text: “Monama nod Longaggon no Motuus to Langun,
motallong ka woy ollog en kos kodhukum du!”

content: Na, id busbus taddot iko-oppat no ponolihan iddos ta-aw taddot kandin no yohung diyon to allow. Woy idda ron en, ayas id monit kos allow taman to noupitan kos mgo minuvu.

Piru ahad noupitan don sikandan, waa ran en id sondit woy'd tanan to morat no pinuungan dan, woy waa ran posivontuhi iddos Monama no duwon kotungud taddon mgo kororattan, ko konna, id sumpalit dan da en baling.

Na, id busbus taddot iko-limmon ponolihan iddos ta-aw taddot kandin no yohung diyon to trunu taddot monnanap no id go-un diyot dahat. Woy idda ron en, id mosukirom kos intirut kohoriyan din. Iyon id puungan to mgo minuvu, id pongahat dan kos dila ran pomon to dii ran od pokoti-is to kosokitoy.

Woy id sumpalit dan da en iddos Monama no riyot datas to langit pomon taddot kosokitoy woy mgo pidsa ran. Piru ahad ungketen kos notomanan dan, waa en sikandan id sondit woy id tanan to morat no pinuungan dan.

Na, id busbus taddot iko-annom no ponolihan iddos ta-aw taddot kandin no yohung diyot dakkoon oweg to Eufrates. Idda ron en, no-ottiyan iddos oweg, su amoy od kovoyan taddot mgo hari no id pomon diyon tid tollak.

Nokita ku iddos otollun moka-arat-arat no busow no id loppow no iling to bakbak. Dos sokkad, id leggua riyot bivig taddot dragon, dos iko-oruwa, id leggua riyot bivig taddot unnon monnanap, woy dos iko-otollu, id leggua riyot bivig taddot iko-oruwon monnanap no idda en so od po-uvag-uvag no propeta.

Ini en kos mgo busow no od puung to mgo mokososoobbu. Id undiyonnan woy id livuung dan kos mgo hari ka-ay to ampow't ingod, amoy od atu to Monama no Motuus to Langun init od inguma no dakkoon allow to kodhukum din.

De-en id livuung dan iddos mgo hari duma to mgo sundau ran diyot lugaa nod ngoranan to Armagedon diyot Hebreo no kinohiyan. Na mid ikahi iddos od Longaggon to, “Pomotawi row! Tigkow a od inguma iling to tokawon. Moppiya kod kotomanan to minuvu no diid tintinuhon woy inaayun od oumpak, oyyos konna sikandin od ko-ilawan init kod-inguma ku.”

Na, id busbus taddot iko-pittun ponolihan iddos ta-aw taddot kandin no yohung diyon to kaamag. Idda ron en, norinog ku no duwon monokkaan bawos pomon diyon to trunu no riyot templo no mid ungketen to, “Nopongnga ron!”
Na, tigkow id kokilat, id pomaansi woy id linug to oray'n monokkaa. Pomon poron to kodbovaa to minuvu ka-ay to ampow't ingod, waa pa linug no iling tadda kos konokkaloy.

Idda ron en, nova-ad don to otollu iddos novantug no bonuwa to Babilonia, woy nongohobba kos langun no bonuwa ka-ay to ampow't ingod, oyyos waa lingawi to Monama iddos saa to mgo toho Babilonia. Noko-iling to id pa-amin to Monama tid po-inom kandan iddos ta-aw to pokawan, no idda en so kodsilut din kandan pomon to lampas no langot din.
Na, nongowora ron kos langun no isla, ahad iddos mgo buvungan.
Woy id uranan pe-en kos mgo minuvu to ays no mgo limmompuun kilu kos kovoggatoy to ipat sokkad. Piru id sumpalit dan da en baling kos Monama pomon taddot moka-arat-arat no kororattan.
